editing_rules: Edit for the story: every cut, transition, zoom or sound serves story, emotion, clarity or retention.
Prioritize pacing: remove dead space, unnecessary pauses and repeated information.
Make audio a priority: clear speech and controlled levels can matter more than flashy visuals.
Keep visuals consistent: continuity, color, framing, text placement and movement direction.
Don't overuse transitions: a clean cut is often more professional.
Guide the viewer's attention with framing, movement, contrast, text and sound.
Keep text readable: enough screen time, strong contrast, an uncrowded frame.
Cut on action when useful so movement carries across the cut.
Use effects with intention: support the message, never distract from it.
Review the final edit without sound; if the visual story is confusing, fix pacing, composition or B-roll.
decision_test: What does this shot, line, sound or effect contribute?
Why does it appear at this moment?

Core editing.meaning: A direct change from one shot to another.
Shorten the beginning or end of a clip.
A visual method of moving from one shot to another.
The main footage: the person speaking or the primary action.
Supporting footage that adds context, variety and visual interest.
A cut within a similar shot that creates a noticeable time jump.
The next shot's audio starts before its picture appears.
The previous shot's audio continues over the next picture.
A cut connected by similar movement, shape, composition or action.
A sequence of shots that compresses time or shows many moments.
The overall speed and rhythm of the edit.
The exact moment for cuts, text, sound and effects.
A musical or rhythmic point that can guide cuts and visual changes.

Composition & continuity.meaning: Place important subjects on a 3x3 grid's balanced areas.
Space between the top of the subject's head and the frame edge.
Space in the direction a subject looks or moves.
Consistent positions, movement, light, props and direction between shots.
Keep the camera on one side of the action axis to preserve screen direction.
Believable eye direction when cutting between subjects.

Audio.meaning: Natural background sound of the location.
Added or recreated sounds that support on-screen action.
Background music placed under narration or visuals.
Lowering music when speech needs focus.
Distortion when levels are too high; the highest signal points.

Color & image.meaning: Natural exposure, white balance and shot-to-shot consistency.
Overall brightness and the spread between dark and bright.
Neutral whites without unwanted color casts.
Natural-looking skin unless a stylized look is intended.

Text & motion.meaning: An information graphic near the bottom of the frame.
Animated text for emphasis or storytelling.
A graphic that introduces a title, section or topic.
Area where text stays visible across players and interfaces.
The most important information is visually dominant.

voice_rubric.label: Prosody

voice_rubric.label: Locale fit
voice_rubric.question: Does the variety fit the brief?

release_gate.note: Illustrative local policy; calibrate with your own listeners. A high average never excuses a critical failure.

duration_hierarchy: Apply a moderate speaking-rate change, then re-evaluate.
If it still cannot fit clearly, report the conflict. Never delete essential conditions or speed up past intelligibility.
before_synthesis: Approve the locale and audience brief.
Verify meaning and the spoken reading of numbers, dates and abbreviations.
Confirm permitted localization and supported engine controls.
Select an approved voice and the duration requirement.
after_synthesis: Listen to the entire take against the script.
Review the start, the end, names, numbers, emphasis, language switches and joins.
Score the take with the rubric.
Save the accepted settings, voice, input and review record.

repair_guide.check: Misplaced boundaries, identical pauses, word-by-word clarity, repetitive intonation.
repair_guide.repair: Simplify the direction and revise thought groups. More pitch variation is not automatically the cure.

repair_guide.symptom: Fluent but foreign to the brief
repair_guide.check: Locale selection, sound contrasts, stress or tone, source-language prosody transfer.
repair_guide.repair: Get target-locale review. Never call a voice native-like only because the model supports the language.

repair_guide.check: Voice selection, per-segment settings, contradictory directions, chunk joins.
repair_guide.repair: Generate coherent passages; never fix one sentence by introducing an inconsistent speaker.
Approve concise wording, reduce pauses, then a moderate rate change. Recheck names and conditions; report the conflict if it still does not fit.
